records.rationale: The historical pointer-to-const-class adjustment belongs to the superseded OF phandle-array helper. Its firmware-node replacement in 45b0ec108d3d passes &power_supply_class to the current native iterator. Retain the generic source API with corrected ownership; replace the earlier broad target omission. Native class type and surrounding code remain unchanged.

The complete historical patch is whitespace-only under git diff -w. Both affected battery-info functions equal pinned LTS after the separate array helper addition. Keep native formatting and behavior; replace the earlier broad target omission rather than describing already present native code as omitted.

previous_decisions.method: Every non-identical affected path has a specific source-selection review and remains at the exact pinned LTS blob. The per-path notes identify represented fixes, excluded APIs or target-specific features.

drivers/power/supply/power_supply_core.c.specific_evidence: The residual adds system-battery enumeration and fwnode-array lookup APIs for the new physical USB-PD negotiation. The SDK virtual-device target packages goldfish_battery, which models the emulator battery directly; the selected guest has no negotiated physical charger/battery topology. Retain native LTS power-supply core and matching headers; no assertion that the generic file is unused.
